Cyberneering and Cyberoptics

Subsystems & Communication across Scales (39)

Within systems are subsystems and within divisions are subdivisions. What's important is not the infinitesimal degree of precision at the micro-level, but how information and communication is translated at different scales.

Within language, we operate with different scales of complexity, along a linear track (Cyberoptics/Cyberocula) a language can describe categories and domains; and yet, the number of different possible arrangements is nonfinite (entropy-f). This suggests categories, prototypes and general-analysis, are either subsystems of a unified system (in this case, it is language) or, they are filters of combinatorial-implosion

Language can describe color, size, location, memory, and virtually, any kind of information encodeable as imaginatory stimuli. Language struggles with high-scales of information noise (specificity), but it excells in filtering

I realized this while building queries and interfaces; these are not the same system, language or even Domain; they are subsystems or a larger unified Domain (in this case, HCI)
